subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: After the required-completion bug is fixed, should maintainers require live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merge, or accept source/test evidence for this session-routing change?
rationale: The PR changes visible Telegram message delivery and session-state routing, and the repository policy treats that proof boundary as maintainer-sensitive.

options.title: Require live Telegram proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing background-task completion reaches the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only proof
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the source and regression-test evidence after the code finding is fixed, while owning the remaining transport delivery risk.

options.title: Pause for broader liveness work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the broader Telegram detached-subagent liveness and terminal-notification contract resolved first.

recommendation.title: Require live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing background-task completion reaches the owning topic with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has broad recent history across heartbeat, task, and subagent delivery boundaries that must align with Telegram-visible behavior.
